events.title: Our Life: N&F Early Access Release Date & Animated Trailer!
events.summary: GB Patch Games is proud to announce that our upcoming title, Our Life: Now & Forever, will have its Early Access release next month, November 27th at 6am US Mountain Time/8am EST!Our Life: Now & Forever is a slice-of-life romance visual novel, following you and your two neighbors from childhood through adulthood.To celebrate, we're debuting a brand new animated trailer, created by the wonderful dreamty_draw. We hope you love it!Also, today is the start of the Steam Next fest! Next Fest highlight

events.title: Fall in Love Visual Novel Festival is live on Steam!
events.summary: The Fall in Love Festival is back! We're honored to be featured in it once again.Both Our Life titles have a spot in the festival and the OLBA DLCs are on sale!Aside from our appearances, you can also check out an incredible lineup of romance-themed games on Steam. We hope you discover a new adventure to fall in love with!The festival runs from September 1st to September 9th. https://store.steampowered.com/curator/46245070/sale/FallinLoveFestival2026

events.title: OLNF Major Demo Update Out Now! 🍂
events.summary: Our Life: Now & Forever has gotten a significant update to its free demo. More childhood wonder and teenage angst await 😄.This might be only a demo, but it has a massive script of 256,000 words (the version before was 161,000 words). Of course, it's not 256k straight through. There are that many words because there's so many alterations within the story based on your personality, relationships, and choices. events.title: Our Life: Now & Forever Mini-Demo Launch! 🍂 (PC)
events.summary: The Our Life: Now & Forever mini-demo is now available! 🎉🎉🎉 You can finally meet the two new leads for the Our Life series and create a character of your own. The demo is under an hour long from start to finish, but it does have enough branches/alterations to be worth playing twice, or even more. We hope you'll enjoy your brand-new story! And, if you're so inclined, we'd love to see the MC(s) that you make 💕
